injuries.comment: Sennecke (upper body) is now considered day-to-day, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports Wednesday.

injuries.name: Leo Carlsson
injuries.comment: out

injuries.name: A.J. Greer
injuries.comment: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

news.notes: Graf will play after being a healthy scratch for two games. ... Carlsson will miss his second straight game after he was injured in a 3-2 loss at the Utah Mammoth on Nov. 21. The center remains day to day. ... Brossoit was recalled from San Diego of the American Hockey League and will start in goal. … The Ducks reassigned defenseman Noah Warren to San Diego on Tuesday.

injuries.comment: Head coach Ryan Warsofsky said Sunday that Chernyshov (upper body) is not close to returning to game action, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
